propositions: The step-budget exhaustion diagnostic (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) is computed by interpret_failure but dropped by _bounded_diagnostic before reaching raise_completion_workflow_failure

No gate_error_v1 sidecar is written and no repetition counters appear in operator-facing messages when budget exhaustion recovery fails, leaving operators unable to distinguish looping from resource exhaustion

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist must be extended to pass repetition summary keys and the merge() function must allow list-typed top_repeated_tool_calls to survive the recovery-exception and primary-exception merges
The operator message must render the aggregate_-prefixed repetition counts via format_repetition after stripping the prefix so operators can see distinct vs total tool calls without reading logs
The sidecar payload must preserve privacy by carrying only hashed signatures and counters, never prompts or tool arguments
Failures without any diagnostic must continue raising bare LLMError unchanged without manufactured sidecars
